bd-citation-sweep-recipe: Dead-bd-citation sweep (angr-9ke6b.238): source/doc comments cite bd by two different kinds of key and only one is checkable with 'bd recall'. Kebab keys (e.g. vex-dispatch-bypass-inventory) are MEMORIES — 'bd recall <key>'; angr-XXXXX ids are BEADS — 'bd recall' always fails on them, use 'bd show <id>'. Sweep recipe: grep -rhoP '(?<=bd )`[a-z][a-z0-9-]{6,}`' native/angr/src/ docs/ angr/ | tr -d '`' | sort -u, then bd recall each and bd show the angr-* ones. As of 2026-08-03 the whole repo cites exactly 6 such keys and all resolve. Round-3 memory prunes are the main source of rot here: a memory forgotten as 'superseded by <doc>' leaves its citations behind, so the repair is to cite the superseding doc SECTION BY NAME (section titles survive refactors; the pruned key does not).
